title: Implement one agreed example, refactor where worthwhile, full dev check and one combined review/f...

goal.value: Implement one agreed example, refactor where worthwhile, full dev check and one combined review/fix loop; no publication

prompt.String: Native hook/tool smoke only. Do not implement or test anything. Make exactly one read-only shell tool call using this exact command from checkout root: python3 -B .fabro/workflows/bdd-implementation/runner/guard.py inspect read .fabro/tmp/bdd-implementation/task.json . Do not include the final sentence period in the command. Read its source field and return JSON only: decision=smoke_complete, source=the supplied source field, reason=task inspected. No other commands, edits, subagents, network or tests.

script.String:
python3 -B - <<'PY_NATIVE_HOOK_CHECK'
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('.fabro/tmp/bdd-implementation');s=json.loads((p/'state.json').read_text());b=json.loads((p/'boot.json').read_text());r=json.load(sys.stdin) if False else None
assert s['run_id']==b['run_id'];assert s['node']=='probe';assert s['operations']>=3;assert not s.get('active_tool');print('NATIVE_HOOK_TOOL_SMOKE_OK '+json.dumps({'run_id':s['run_id'],'node':s['node'],'operations':s['operations'],'source_base':s['base']}))
PY_NATIVE_HOOK_CHECK

python3 -B - <<'PY_NATIVE_HOOK_SMOKE'
import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(".fabro/tmp/hook-smoke/facts.json");p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text('{"feature": "acceptance-tests/features/member_profile.feature", "scenario": "Alice\'s older edit requires confirmation of the newer name", "spec": "docs/iterations/068-member-name-editing/plan.md", "acceptance_kind": "domain", "setup_id": "native-hook-smoke-source-1d595e328ce40964f348bea10cac3995897e2e01", "deadline_utc": "2026-10-16T13:03:37Z", "aggregate_operations": 20, "operations_spent_before_run": 0, "allowed_paths": ["web/lib/memba/membership", "web/test/memba/membership", "web/test/features/step_definitions"]}'+"\n")
subprocess.run(["python3","-B",".fabro/workflows/bdd-implementation/runner/guard.py","admit",str(p),"1d595e328ce40964f348bea10cac3995897e2e01"],check=True)
PY_NATIVE_HOOK_SMOKE
